channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Is Europe preparing for a wider war with Russia?
item.description: A British war-game show simulating a Russian attack has drawn a nuclear warning from Moscow.

item.title: Birzeit University memorial destruction aims to crush Palestinian memory
item.description: Israeli soldiers removed the monument to students and alumni killed by Israel and replaced it with a fig sapling.

item.title: What new measures is Iran taking to counter US economic pressure?
item.description: Iran adopts a new arrangement to tackle economic challenges amid the US-imposed economic war and naval blockades.

item.title: In Gaza, we cannot even begin to recover from trauma
item.description: The genocide has killed many and left the rest broken. For us, survivors, recovery is not on the horizon.

item.title: Hormuz ship attacks surge: Are increased oil exports sustainable?
item.description: Gulf oil flows surge despite escalating ship attacks in the critical Strait of Hormuz energy corridor.

item.title: Mapping where US bombers are based globally
item.description: The US has pulled its B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford amid Iran fears. Here's where else they can fly from.

item.title: Pakistan, Turkiye and Saudi deterrence against Houthis: What that means
item.description: Islamabad says its role is defensive, but Riyadh's offensive in Yemen tests how long it can stay out of the fight.

item.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
item.description: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.

item.title: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
item.description: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.

item.title: Nigeria mourns 25 killed as military plane crashes into swamp
item.description: President Bola Tinubu describes the crash as a "painful moment" for the military and the entire nation.
